components.name: Estep home identity
components.description: One original stepped E and real-text Estep name. A 48px mark with a 28px name, 26px in the spine; touch landscape hides the name at height ≤500px. Subject metadata is absent from the header.
components.html: Estep

components.name: Estep launch mark
components.description: The phone splash silhouette exists at frame one. This mark-only specimen shows the point’s real 600ms trajectory after an 80ms delay. The full eligible phone cover fades at 720–900ms and is skipped under reduced motion or restored navigation.
components.html: EstepEesti keel · A2/B1

components.name: Phone skill navigation
components.description: Static native tab-row specimen with exact source labels/icons and phone padding. glide.js positions one selection capsule and an inert 1.12× lens from the measured tab geometry; preview changes no panel/history, release commits and edge dragging scrolls. Keyboard and quick taps retain their ordinary behavior.
components.css: .ds-skill-nav{display:flex;gap:2px;margin:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:8px var(--gutter,16px);font-family:var(--f-ui,"Geologica",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif);font-variation-settings:var(--soft,"SHRP" 0);}.ds-skill-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.ds-skill-nav button{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-size:var(--fs-ui,15px);font-weight:600;color:var(--muted,#566376);white-space:nowrap;border-radius:999px;transition:color var(--quick,140ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)),background-color var(--quick,140ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-skill-nav button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--accent,#0030de);background:var(--glass-strong,rgba(255,255,255,.82));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--glass-edge,rgba(13,23,38,.06))}.ds-skill-nav button:hover:not([aria-selected="true"]){color:var(--ink,#0f172a);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink,#0f172a) 5%,transparent)}.ds-skill-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0030de);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}.ds-skill-nav .ds-ico{display:inline-flex;line-height:0}.ds-skill-nav .ds-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px;display:block}.ds-skill-nav .ds-duo{display:none}

components.name: Phone mode dock
components.description: Phone dock visual specimen without viewport-fixed placement in the panel. In the app it floats clear of the home indicator, folds while scrolling and hides while typing. It shares the same press/slide/release lens as the skill row; all displayed icons come from the current source.
components.css: .ds-modes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:6px;border-radius:30px;background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.64));-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(1.8);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(1.8);box-shadow:var(--glass-lift);font-family:var(--f-ui,"Geologica",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif);font-variation-settings:var(--soft,"SHRP" 0);}.ds-modes button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-width:0;min-height:56px;padding:4px 2px;border:0;border-radius:24px;background:none;color:var(--ink-2,#3d4b5e);font:inherit;font-size:var(--fs-gloss,12px);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--t,240ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)),color var(--t,240ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)),transform var(--quick,140ms) var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-modes button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--ctl);color:var(--accent,#0030de)}.ds-modes button:hover:not([aria-selected="true"]){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink,#0f172a) 5%,transparent)}.ds-modes button:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-modes button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0030de);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}.ds-modes .ds-ico{line-height:0}.ds-modes .ds-ico svg{width:24px;height:24px}.ds-modes .ds-duo{display:none}@media (prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce),(prefers-contrast:more){.ds-modes{background:var(--panel,#fff);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-modes button{transition:none}}

components.name: Profile / login control
components.description: The 44px profile link opens #profile. This specimen is the signed-in state; profile.js swaps its label and icon to Logi sisse/sign-in for the signed-out scope. It sits beside the existing theme button.

narrative.northStar: Laudtee — the existing boardwalk learning-path metaphor
narrative.overview: Estep means Estonian + step. One stepped E marks the identity; the established boardwalk still draws the curriculum, while the cornflower shows contact with four exam parts. Cool near-white content and floating glass navigation retain the current Geologica and Estonian-blue system.
keyCharacteristics: 48px stepped-E mark and 28px name, 26px in the spine; no header descriptor
One inert phone lens previews navigation; release activates the destination
Russian name explanation and server-supplied UTC year beside retained source disclosure
dos: Do generate every identity derivative from the canonical vector.
Do preserve code-decided learning evidence and source attribution.
Do keep native taps, keyboard navigation and automatic accessibility fallbacks.
donts: Do not identify the boardwalk metaphor as the app name.
Do not preview a panel or write URL history while dragging the phone lens.
Do not put linguistic or mastery claims into the identity.
